name: v3_elado_helmholtz
_comment: CONTROL (out of scope). ELADO Helmholtz set E1 (E1_test.h5): x = wavenumber field a, y = |u| (u complex, source a fixed centred Gaussian that is not stored). Mapped exactly like the Poisson sibling (x -> k, y -> u, uniform source 1), i.e. what a user running one preset on every ELADO file would do.
